_comment: Exploration palette — 2-color linear gradients with a topographic texture overlay tiled 4x on bordered cards. All colors are Tailwind defaults; tokens are the source of truth, hex values are the compiled output.

indigo_slate._description: Soft indigo → slate. Muted, monochromatic feel.

texture_overlay.description: Seamless topographic / organic-line pattern. Low-opacity overlay on top of the gradient. Tiled 4x across a bordered card. Standalone gradient tiles use a single instance.

inner_card._note: Cream (#F5F4EB) is the default inner bottom panel. Some variants may use a lighter tint of the gradient's primary color — confirm if we want variant-specific inner tints.
